QuestInfo.name: Spy or Victim?
QuestInfo.0: Is #p2151005# really a spy? #p2159200# needs to explain himself!
QuestInfo.1: #p2159200# felt strange after taking some of #p2151005#'s medicine. He kept an eye on her after that, and discovered that it was actually poison. He wants you to report his findings to #p2152004#, and keep an eye on #p2151005#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152004# couldn't believe the report, but agreed to keep a close eye on #p2151005#.
